import FourOffTwinModel189
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum

namespace OffFive16DisconnectedSingle
open Finset
abbrev Marks := Fin 10 → Fin 3
abbrev Vertex := Fin 12

def dir (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (v w : Vertex) : Bool :=
  let a := v.val
  let b := w.val
  decide (b=a+1 ∧ b≤10) ||
  decide ((a=1 ∨ a=j) ∧ b=11) ||
  (if h : a=0 ∧ 1≤b ∧ b≤10 then decide (m ⟨b-1,by omega⟩=1) else false) ||
  (if h : b=10 ∧ a<10 then decide (m ⟨a,h.2⟩=2) else false)

def edge (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (v w : Vertex) : Bool := dir j m v w || dir j m w v

def two (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (v : Vertex) : Finset Vertex :=
  univ.filter fun w => w≠v ∧ !edge j m v w=true ∧
    ∃ t : Vertex,edge j m v t=true ∧ edge j m t w=true

def witnesses (j : ℕ) (w : Vertex) : List Vertex :=
  if w.val=0 ∨ w.val=10 then List.finRange 12
  else if w.val=11 then [1,Fin.ofNat' 12 j]
  else [Fin.ofNat' 12 (w.val-1),Fin.ofNat' 12 (w.val+1),0,10,11]

def fastTwo (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (v : Vertex) : Finset Vertex :=
  univ.filter fun w => w≠v ∧ !edge j m v w=true ∧
    (witnesses j w).any (fun t => edge j m v t && edge j m t w)=true

theorem fast_sub (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (v : Vertex) : fastTwo j m v⊆two j m v := by
  intro w wm
  obtain ⟨_,ne,no,se⟩ := mem_filter.mp wm
  obtain ⟨t,_,tse⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp se
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at tse
  exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _,ne,no,t,tse.1,tse.2⟩

def count (m : Marks) (v : Fin 3) : ℕ :=
  (univ.filter fun k => m k=v).card

def codeSites (j : ℕ) : List (Fin 10) :=
  (List.finRange 10).filter (fun k => decide (1≤k.val ∧ k.val≤8 ∧ (j=9 ∨ (k.val≠1 ∧ k.val≠j))))

def pick : List (Fin 10)→ List (Fin 3)→ Fin 10→Fin 3
  | a::as,b::bs,k => if a=k then b else pick as bs k
  | _,_,_ => 0

theorem pick_map {L : List (Fin 10)} {m : Marks} {k : Fin 10} (km : k∈L) :
    pick L (L.map m) k=m k := by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp at km
  | cons a L ih =>
    by_cases ae : a=k
    · subst a
      simp [pick]
    · simp [pick,ae,ih ((List.mem_cons.mp km).resolve_left (Ne.symm ae))]

def decode (j : ℕ) (d : List (Fin 3)) (k : Fin 10) : Fin 3 :=
  if k.val=0 then 1 else if k.val=9 then 2 else pick (codeSites j) d k

theorem decode_full (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (m0 : m 0=1) (m9 : m 9=2)
    (holes : j≠9 → ∀ k : Fin 10,(k.val=1 ∨ k.val=j) → m k=0) :
    decode j ((codeSites j).map m)=m := by
  funext k
  unfold decode
  split
  next h => rw [show k=0 from Fin.ext h,m0]
  split
  next h => rw [show k=9 from Fin.ext h,m9]
  next kn9 =>
    by_cases km : k∈codeSites j
    · exact pick_map km
    have kv := k.isLt
    have t : j≠9 ∧ (k.val=1 ∨ k.val=j) := by
      by_contra n
      apply km
      refine List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨List.mem_finRange _,?_⟩
      apply decide_eq_true
      refine ⟨by omega,by omega,?_⟩
      by_cases jj : j=9
      · exact .inl jj
      · exact .inr ⟨fun e => n ⟨jj,.inl e⟩,fun e => n ⟨jj,.inr e⟩⟩
    have zp (L : List (Fin 10)) (non : k∉L) : pick L (L.map m) k=0 := by
      induction L with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons v L ih =>
        have ne : v≠k := fun e => non (by simp [e])
        have la : k∉L := fun e => non (by simp [e])
        simp [pick,ne,ih la]
    rw [zp _ km,holes t.1 k t.2]

def words : ℕ → List (List (Fin 3))
  | 0 => [[]]
  | n+1 => (words n).flatMap fun d => [0::d,1::d,2::d]

theorem mem_words (d : List (Fin 3)) : d∈words d.length := by
  induction d with
  | nil => simp [words]
  | cons a d ih =>
    apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
    refine ⟨d,ih,?_⟩
    fin_cases a <;> simp

def candidates : List (ℕ×List (Fin 3)) :=
  [(5,[1,0,1,1,1,0,2,2,2,2]),(6,[1,0,2,1,1,1,0,2,2,2]),
   (7,[1,0,2,2,1,1,1,0,2,2]),(8,[1,0,2,2,2,1,1,1,0,2]),
   (9,[1,0,1,1,1,2,2,2,0,2]),(9,[1,0,2,2,2,1,1,1,0,2]),
   (9,[1,2,2,2,0,0,1,1,1,2]),(9,[1,2,2,2,0,1,1,1,1,2]),
   (9,[1,2,2,2,1,1,1,1,1,2]),(9,[1,2,2,2,2,0,1,1,1,2]),
   (9,[1,2,2,2,2,1,1,1,1,2]),(9,[1,2,2,2,2,2,1,1,1,2])]

def candidate (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) : Bool :=
  candidates.any (fun q => decide (q.1=j ∧ q.2=List.ofFn m))

def valid (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) : Prop :=
  4≤count m 1 ∧ 4≤count m 2 ∧ m 1≠1 ∧ m (Fin.ofNat' 10 j)≠1 ∧ m (Fin.ofNat' 10 (j-1))≠2
instance (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) : Decidable (valid j m) := by unfold valid; infer_instance

def gate (j : ℕ) (d : List (Fin 3)) : Bool :=
  if 3≤d.count 1 ∧ 3≤d.count 2 then
    let m := decode j d
    !(decide (valid j m ∧
      (fastTwo j m 0).card≤4 ∧ (fastTwo j m 10).card≤4 ∧ (fastTwo j m 11).card≤4)) ||
       candidate j m
  else true

def mixedMarks (j : ℕ) : Bool :=
  (OffFour16Twin.bitlists (codeSites j).length).all (gate j)

def boundaryMarks (head : Fin 3) : Bool :=
  ((words ((codeSites 9).length-1)).map (head::·)).all (gate 9)

end OffFive16DisconnectedSingle

namespace OffFive16DisconnectedSingle
open Finset

private theorem count_from_site_color {j : ℕ} {m : Marks} {col : Fin 3}
    (h0 : m 0=1) (h10 : m 9=2)
    (holes : j≠9 → ∀ k : Fin 10,(k.val=1 ∨ k.val=j) → m k=0)
    (hc : col=1 ∨ col=2) (four : 4≤count m col) :
    3≤((codeSites j).map m).count col := by
  classical
  let d : Fin 10 := if col=1 then 0 else 9
  let A := (univ : Finset (Fin 10)).filter (fun k => m k=col)
  let L := (codeSites j).filter (fun k => m k == col)
  have dc : m d=col := by rcases hc with rfl|rfl <;> simp [d,h0,h10]
  have nb : col≠0 := by rcases hc with rfl|rfl <;> decide
  have Aeq : L.toFinset=A.erase d := by
    ext k
    constructor
    · intro kL
      obtain ⟨kf,kc⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp (List.mem_toFinset.mp kL)
      have ts := of_decide_eq_true (List.mem_filter.mp kf).2
      have kd : k≠d := by
        intro ek
        rcases hc with rfl|rfl
        · have e : k.val=0 := by simpa [d] using congrArg Fin.val ek
          omega
        · have e : k.val=9 := by simpa [d] using congrArg Fin.val ek
          omega
      exact mem_erase.mpr ⟨kd,mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _,beq_iff_eq.mp kc⟩⟩
    · intro km
      obtain ⟨kd,kA⟩ := mem_erase.mp km
      have kc := (mem_filter.mp kA).2
      have k0 : k.val≠0 := by
        intro eq
        have kk : k=0 := Fin.ext eq
        rcases hc with rfl|rfl
        · exact kd (by simpa [d] using kk)
        · rw [kk,h0] at kc; contradiction
      have k10 : k.val≠9 := by
        intro eq
        have kk : k=9 := Fin.ext eq
        rcases hc with rfl|rfl
        · rw [kk,h10] at kc; contradiction
        · exact kd (by simpa [d] using kk)
      have h : j=9 ∨ (k.val≠1 ∧ k.val≠j) := by
        by_cases jj : j=9
        · exact .inl jj
        exact .inr ⟨fun e => nb (kc.symm.trans (holes jj k (.inl e))),
          fun e => nb (kc.symm.trans (holes jj k (.inr e)))⟩
      apply List.mem_toFinset.mpr
      exact List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨List.mem_finRange _,decide_eq_true ⟨by omega,by have isLt := k.isLt; omega,h⟩⟩,
        beq_iff_eq.mpr kc⟩
  have ns : (codeSites j).Nodup := (List.nodup_finRange 10).filter _
  have nd : L.Nodup := ns.filter _
  have cEq : ((codeSites j).map m).count col=L.length := by
    rw [List.count,List.countP_map,List.countP_eq_length_filter]
    rfl
  have ca := congrArg Finset.card Aeq
  have da : d∈A := mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _,dc⟩
  rw [List.toFinset_card_of_nodup nd,card_erase_of_mem da] at ca
  change 4≤A.card at four
  omega


theorem strictly_reduce_marks
    (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (m0 : m 0=1) (m9 : m 9=2)
    (holes : j≠9 → ∀ k : Fin 10,(k.val=1 ∨ k.val=j) → m k=0)
    (nonzero : j≠9 → ∀ k∈codeSites j,m k≠0)
    (v : valid j m)
    (c0 : (two j m 0).card≤4) (c10 : (two j m 10).card≤4)
    (c11 : (two j m 11).card≤4)
    (mixed : j≠9 → mixedMarks j=true)
    (ends : ∀ d : Fin 3,boundaryMarks d=true) :
    candidate j m=true := by
  let d := (codeSites j).map m
  have dlen : d.length=(codeSites j).length := by simp [d]
  have he : gate j d=true := by
    by_cases neq : j≠9
    · have dm : d∈OffFour16Twin.bitlists (codeSites j).length := by
        rw [←dlen]
        apply OffFour16Twin.mem_bitlists
        intro s sm
        obtain ⟨k,km,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp sm
        exact nonzero neq k km
      exact List.all_eq_true.mp (mixed neq) d dm
    have eq : j=9 := not_ne_iff.mp neq
    subst j
    cases ed : d with
    | nil =>
      have len8 : (codeSites 9).length=8 := by decide
      simp [ed,len8] at dlen
    | cons head tail =>
      have tl : tail.length=(codeSites 9).length-1 := by
        rw [ed,List.length_cons] at dlen
        omega
      have tm : tail∈words ((codeSites 9).length-1) := by rw [←tl]; exact mem_words tail
      exact List.all_eq_true.mp (ends head) (head::tail) (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨tail,tm,rfl⟩)
  have fl := (card_le_card (fast_sub j m 0)).trans c0
  have fr := (card_le_card (fast_sub j m 10)).trans c10
  have fx := (card_le_card (fast_sub j m 11)).trans c11
  have raw : 3≤d.count 1 ∧ 3≤d.count 2 :=
    ⟨count_from_site_color m0 m9 holes (.inl rfl) v.1,
      count_from_site_color m0 m9 holes (.inr rfl) v.2.1⟩
  have eq : decode j d=m := decode_full j m m0 m9 holes
  simpa [gate,raw,eq,v,fl,fr,fx] using he

#print axioms strictly_reduce_marks

end OffFive16DisconnectedSingle

import OffFiveDiscSingleBase189
namespace OffFive16DisconnectedSingle
open Finset

abbrev Label := Fin 16
abbrev Tuple := ℕ×ℕ×ℕ×ℕ

def port (P : Tuple) (k : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if k=12 then P.1 else if k=13 then P.2.1 else if k=14 then P.2.2.1 else P.2.2.2

def coreDir (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (P : Tuple) (v w : Label) : Bool :=
  ((if h : v.val<12 ∧ w.val<12 then dir j m ⟨v.val,h.1⟩ ⟨w.val,h.2⟩ else false) ||
    decide (12≤v.val ∧ v.val<w.val)) ||
    decide (v.val=port P w.val ∧ 12≤w.val)

def coreEdge (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (P : Tuple) (v w : Label) : Bool :=
  coreDir j m P v w || coreDir j m P w v

def coreTwo (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (P : Tuple) (u : Label) : Finset Label :=
  univ.filter fun v => v≠u ∧ !coreEdge j m P u v=true ∧
    ∃ w : Label,coreEdge j m P u w=true ∧ coreEdge j m P w v=true

def coreWs (j : ℕ) (P : Tuple) (v : Label) : List Label :=
  if v.val=0 ∨ v.val=10 then List.finRange 16
  else if v.val=11 then [1,Fin.ofNat' 16 j]
  else if v.val≤10 then
    [Fin.ofNat' 16 (v.val-1),Fin.ofNat' 16 (v.val+1),0,10,11,12,13,14,15]
  else [Fin.ofNat' 16 (port P v.val),12,13,14,15]

def fastCore (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (P : Tuple) (u : Label) : Finset Label :=
  univ.filter fun v => v≠u ∧ !coreEdge j m P u v=true ∧
    (coreWs j P v).any (fun w => coreEdge j m P u w && coreEdge j m P w v)=true

theorem fastCore_sub (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (P : Tuple) (u : Label) :
    fastCore j m P u⊆coreTwo j m P u := by
  intro v vm
  obtain ⟨_,ne,no,se⟩ := mem_filter.mp vm
  obtain ⟨w,_,wse⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp se
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at wse
  exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _,ne,no,w,wse.1,wse.2⟩

def admissible (j k : ℕ) : Prop := 1≤k ∧ k≤9 ∧ k≠1 ∧ k≠j
instance (j k : ℕ) : Decidable (admissible j k) := by unfold admissible; infer_instance
def separated (k h : ℕ) : Prop := k=h ∨ k+3≤h
instance (k h : ℕ) : Decidable (separated k h) := by unfold separated; infer_instance

def sites (j : ℕ) : List ℕ := (List.range 10).filter (fun k => decide (admissible j k))

def tuples (j : ℕ) : List Tuple :=
  (sites j).flatMap fun x => (sites j).flatMap fun y =>
    if separated x y then (sites j).flatMap fun z =>
      if separated y z then (sites j).filterMap fun w =>
        if separated z w ∧ x≠w then some (x,y,z,w) else none
      else []
    else []

theorem mem_tuples {j x y z w : ℕ}
    (ax : admissible j x) (ay : admissible j y) (az : admissible j z) (aw : admissible j w)
    (xy : separated x y) (yz : separated y z) (zw : separated z w) (xw : x≠w) :
    (x,y,z,w)∈tuples j := by
  have memSite {k : ℕ} (a : admissible j k) : k∈sites j :=
    List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨List.mem_range.mpr (by have t := a.2.1; omega),decide_eq_true a⟩
  apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
  refine ⟨x,memSite ax,?_⟩
  apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
  refine ⟨y,memSite ay,?_⟩
  simp only [if_pos xy]
  apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
  refine ⟨z,memSite az,?_⟩
  simp only [if_pos yz]
  exact List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨w,memSite aw,by simp [zw,xw]⟩

def fromList (l : List (Fin 3)) (k : Fin 10) : Fin 3 := l[k.val]?.getD 0

theorem fromList_ofFn (m : Marks) : fromList (List.ofFn m)=m := by

def Chain (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (P : Tuple) (l : List Label) : Prop :=
  l.Nodup ∧ (∀ v : Label,v∈l) ∧ l.Chain' (fun v w => coreEdge j m P v w=true)
instance (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (P : Tuple) (l : List Label) : Decidable (Chain j m P l) := by unfold Chain; infer_instance

    pool.all (fun q => decide (Chain q.j (fromList q.signs) q.pins q.path))=true := by decide +kernel

def hasPath (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (P : Tuple) : Bool :=
  pool.any fun q => decide (q.j=j ∧ q.signs=List.ofFn m ∧ q.pins=P)

theorem hasPath_sound {j : ℕ} {m : Marks} {P : Tuple} (yes : hasPath j m P=true) :
    ∃ l : List Label,Chain j m P l := by
  obtain ⟨q,hq,h⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp yes
  obtain ⟨a,b,c⟩ := of_decide_eq_true h
  have V := of_decide_eq_true (List.all_eq_true.mp pool_good q hq)
  exact ⟨q.path,by simpa only [a,b,c,fromList_ofFn] using V⟩

def gateCore (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (P : Tuple) : Bool :=
    !(decide ((fastCore j m P 0).card≤4 ∧ (fastCore j m P 10).card≤4 ∧
      (fastCore j m P 11).card≤4 ∧ (fastCore j m P 12).card≤4 ∧
      (fastCore j m P 13).card≤4 ∧ (fastCore j m P 14).card≤4 ∧ (fastCore j m P 15).card≤4))
    || hasPath j m P

def coreRow (j : ℕ) (signs : List (Fin 3)) : Bool :=
  (tuples j).all (gateCore j (fromList signs))

theorem pass_core_row {j : ℕ} {m : Marks} {P : Tuple}
    (good : coreRow j (List.ofFn m)=true) (pm : P∈tuples j)
    (c0 : (coreTwo j m P 0).card≤4) (c10 : (coreTwo j m P 10).card≤4)
    (c11 : (coreTwo j m P 11).card≤4) (c12 : (coreTwo j m P 12).card≤4)
    (c13 : (coreTwo j m P 13).card≤4) (c14 : (coreTwo j m P 14).card≤4)
    (c15 : (coreTwo j m P 15).card≤4) :
    ∃ l : List Label,Chain j m P l := by
  have h := List.all_eq_true.mp good P pm
  change gateCore j (fromList (List.ofFn m)) P=true at h
  rw [fromList_ofFn] at h
  have sub (v : Label) := card_le_card (fastCore_sub j m P v)
  have yes : hasPath j m P=true := by
    simpa [gateCore,(sub 0).trans c0,(sub 10).trans c10,(sub 11).trans c11,
      (sub 12).trans c12,(sub 13).trans c13,(sub 14).trans c14,(sub 15).trans c15] using h
  exact hasPath_sound yes

end OffFive16DisconnectedSingle
